events.title: Demo Update v1.0.1!
events.summary: Hey everyone!We've had a great response already to the initial demo release, thanks to everyone who's checked it out so far! I've published a new demo version 1.0.1 implementing some small bug fixes, QoL improvements, and balancing of the upgrade tree in accordance with some of the early feedback we've received.Change Notes:Resolved issue of default resolution being in 16:10 aspect ratio on 16:9 monitorsOverhauled pricing structure and calculations for UpgradesAdded speed ramp to scoring process

events.title: Slots Up Demo is Out Now!
events.summary: Hey Everyone!I'm excited to announce today that the demo for our next game 'Slots Up!' is now live and available to play on PC, Mac, and Steam Deck natively! 🥳🎉This is possibly the most important stage of this game and YOU will directly influence how the final product looks; your feedback, your response, your input will all dictate our upcoming roadmap and scope for this game.As it stands, I'll be listening intently for your thoughts and feedback as I continue to develop and update the demo. Fro
